title: Create a rich-text block and see it on the canvas
description: Verifies a user can create a new block, enter text, finish editing, and the block appears on the canvas as a node/card.

steps.description: Fill in the block text with "Block A: brainstorm seed"
Verify the new block appears on the canvas

title: Create a node and place it on the canvas
description: Verifies a user can add a new node, move it, and it remains positioned where placed on the canvas.

steps.description: Move the node to a new position on the canvas
Verify the node remains at the new position after releasing it

title: Delete a block and remove it everywhere
description: Verifies a user can delete a block and it is removed from both the block list and the canvas with no leftover representation.

steps.description: Fill in the block text with "Block to delete"
Verify the deleted block is not present in the block list
Verify the deleted block is not present on the canvas

title: Rearrange blocks and see positions reflected on the canvas
description: Verifies a user can create multiple blocks, rearrange them, and the updated order/positions are reflected on the canvas representation.

steps.description: Fill in the block text with "Block A"
Fill in the block text with "Block B"
Verify the canvas reflects the updated block order and/or positions

title: Arrange multiple nodes and preserve relative spacing across zoom levels
description: Verifies a user can add multiple nodes, arrange them spatially, zoom out and back in, and their relative positions remain stable.

steps.description: Move the two nodes into a clear spatial arrangement with separation
Verify both nodes are still present and maintain their relative spacing/arrangement

title: Edit multiple blocks and keep edits through rearranging
description: Verifies a user can edit text in multiple blocks and then rearrange blocks without losing the edits during the session.

steps.description: Fill in the block text with "Block A initial"
Fill in the block text with "Block B initial"
Fill in the block text with "Block A updated"
Fill in the block text with "Block B updated"
Verify the updated block texts are displayed in their blocks
Verify the canvas shows nodes corresponding to the edited blocks

title: Zoom in and out updates canvas scale without losing node positions
description: Verifies zooming changes the canvas scale while keeping existing nodes visible and positioned consistently.

steps.description: Move the node to a distinctive position on the canvas
Verify the canvas zoom level changes
Verify the node remains positioned consistently relative to the canvas after zooming

title: Rapid create-move-zoom interactions keep the board responsive
description: Verifies the app remains responsive and visually consistent during a rapid sequence of adding nodes, dragging, and zooming.

steps.description: Move the first node to a new position on the canvas
Move the second node to a new position on the canvas
Verify the canvas remains interactive and nodes remain visible without visual desynchronization

title: Delete a block while it is being edited
description: Verifies a user can delete the currently edited block and the UI exits editing without leaving an orphan block or stuck focus.

steps.description: Fill in the block text with "Draft content"
Delete the block while it is in edit mode
Verify the block is removed from the block list
Verify no corresponding node remains on the canvas

title: Prevent creating an empty or whitespace-only block
description: Verifies the editor prevents creating a meaningful new block with empty or whitespace-only content, keeping the UI consistent.

steps.description: Fill in the block text with "   "
Verify an input validation or empty-state indication is shown for the block and no usable block content is created
